definitions.gloss: morning person; early riser type; morning-oriented
definitions.explanation: A person or lifestyle pattern characterized by waking up early and being most productive in the morning hours.

⟦{受験|じゅけん}{勉強|べんきょう}→受験勉強：09977_jukenbenkyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{朝型|あさがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えた→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I switched to a morning-oriented lifestyle for exam preparation.

examples.english: Since switching to a morning schedule, my work efficiency has improved.

notes:
{朝型|あさがた} describes a morning-oriented person or lifestyle — someone who wakes early and is most active in the morning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝型|あさがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: morning-oriented lifestyle
- {朝型|あさがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧: a morning person
- {朝型|あさがた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧/⟦{切|き}り{替|か}える→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧: to switch to a morning schedule

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夜型|よるがた}→夜型：20463_yorugata⟧: night-owl type (antonym)
- {朝型|あさがた} vs. ⟦{夜型|よるがた}→夜型：20463_yorugata⟧ is a common topic in lifestyle, health, and productivity discussions in Japan.

FORMS:
⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ (morning) + {型|がた} (type/pattern). The suffix 〜{型|がた} is productive: ⟦{夜型|よるがた}→夜型：20463_yorugata⟧, A{型|がた} (blood type A), etc.
